sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully targets ships, requires both metre-valued decimal quantities on the authoritative owner, and correctly rejects clearance values below the minimum threshold.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Enforce singular, unambiguous quantities: add sh:maxCount 1 to both ship-level clearance properties and to qudt:numericValue and qudt:unit. In particular, sh:hasValue unit:M with only sh:minCount permits an additional non-metre unit to pass; constrain the unit to exactly one unit:M value before freezing.
